text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with
Mayano
Top Gun...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? Do you ever watch live
streams
online?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, I actually started live streaming!
choice_data_list: いきなりどうしたんだ？
choice_data_list_en: What's with you all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I dance to popular songs, play games
with Teio...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And do all sorts of other fun stuff!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Drop by my stream! You'll come and
watch me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I succumb to Mayano Top Gun's fiery
persistence
and agree to watch her next
live stream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I open up her
channel...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna land in everyone's hearts! ☆
Time to
start the show here on Channel
Maya! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Today's guest is my friend, Marvey!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hello! ☆ I hope everyone's marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Comments
text_block_list.text:
Viewer A: I've missed you, Maya! Viewer
B: I
dunno what exactly you mean by
that, but sure,
I'm marvelous. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the comments! I missed you
all too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Today, the two of us are going to visit
some
marvelous places. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My engines are fired up for the Coffee
Cup Top
Speed Challenge!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ We've got lots of marvelous
traveling
to do today. ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the arcade! We're gonna beat
Teio's
high score!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! ☆ I hope we get an
ultra-marvelous
score! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, they stream from various
locations.
The audience seems to be
enjoying their
high-energy shenanigans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They shine as bright as the sun, with
charisma that
could draw anyone in...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mayano Top Gun's stream, I'm
once
again reminded of her appeal.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Okay then. It's time to wrap things up.
Did
everyone have fun?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she poses the question, I find
myself
typing a comment.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks!
choice_data_list: 見ているこっちも楽しかった！
いつも応援してるよ。レース頑張って！
choice_data_list_en: It was a blast just watching you!
I'm always rooting for you. Good luck in the race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I was able to make you all
excited and
get your engines roaring! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All of your comments make me
super-duper
happy too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun flashes an incredibly
bright
smile as she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I promise myself that I will continue
supporting
her in order to see her smile
like that again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'm so much more than just a cute lady. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I have lots of different womanly charms,
and I'll
show them off to you all as I race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sooo! ☆ Please support me—not just as
a
streamer, but during my races too ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know her appeal as a racer better than
anyone
else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself wishing that the audience
who only
came to know her through her
live streams could
see her shine during a
race too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa! You really watched my live
stream
yesterday, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Don't tell me—was this you?!
choice_data_list_en: I sent a comment too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She points out the comment that I left
her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It was you, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When I read that comment, I got this
nice warm
feeling inside—the same way I
feel when I'm with
you!
choice_data_list: すごい！よくわかったな
すごいね！よくわかったね

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But since we're always together, you
might as well
tell me directly, y'know? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her words, Mayano Top Gun
looks pretty
pleased.
